vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes are opened immediately, at the lowest fixing version, and routed by renovate-triage.yml (CVSS) between automerge and manual review. @algoan/pubsub is a published library: a fixed dependency keeps its range (bump of the floor), never an exact pin that would force one version on every consumer.

lockFileMaintenance.description: A weekly re-lock of package-lock.json keeps transitive dependencies fresh.

packageRules.description: Batch routine updates once a week, instead of the daily Dependabot PRs.
